title: Service degradation catalog and incident autopsy canvas
creator: Harper Lin
description:
Goal: Create a compact, actionable catalog of service degradation signatures and a linked visual "autopsy canvas" that lets on-call and SRE quickly map from symptom -> telemetry -> probable root cause. This ticket covers taxonomy definition, schema for trace/log enrichment, required metric counters, and three Grafana dashboards (Degradation Map, Error Slice Explorer, Incident Autopsy Canvas).

Scope:
- Define failure signatures for timeouts, overloaded workers, model-level failures (OOM, decode errors, generation truncation), HTTP/gRPC codes and proxies, client-side aborts, and retry-induced amplification.
- Propose standardized trace/log fields and enum values (e.g. redwood.error_class, redwood.model_status, redwood.slo_bucket) and a migration plan for instrumented services.
- Implement tracing hooks in runtime that add fields when failures are observed and propagate trace_id through gateways.
- Wire enriched spans to metrics/log pipelines (Prometheus histograms, counter labels; logs to Loki/Elastic with structured fields).
- Build dashboards and alert rules; verify with injection test harness.

Constraints & trade-offs:
- We avoid full-fidelity distributed sampling for initial rollout due to storage costs; instead we implement adaptive sampling (retain 100% for high-severity signatures, 1% baseline otherwise).
- Schema must be compact for label cardinality limits: prefer coarse enums with optional freeform tags only attached to sampled traces.

Success metrics: Reduced time-to-root-cause for P1 inference degradations from current median of 28m to <10m; reduction in duplicate incident pages by 30% within first quarter after rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical taxonomy covering timeouts, overload, model-level errors, HTTP/gRPC codes, and retry outcomes documented and linked to metrics/trace tags
Dashboards: Degradation Map, Error Slice Explorer, and Autopsy Canvas implemented and accessible to SRE/Oncall with templating by route/model/region
Tracing hooks emit standardized fields (redwood.trace_id, redwood.error_class, redwood.model_status) and the runtime attaches these automatically on error paths
Metrics & logs pipeline mappings defined and implemented (Prometheus counters/histograms + structured logs to Loki/Elastic) with low-cardinality labels
Alert rules and SLI mappings updated; runbook snippets created for the top 5 degradation signatures
End-to-end test: simulated overload and model error replay produce expected dashboard signals and alert firing; retention and sampling verified
comments: 2026-02-11: Kickoff - alignment with SRE, runtime, and console teams. Agreed on minimal schema to avoid high label cardinality. (Harper)

2026-02-18: Design review - UX asked that Autopsy Canvas include clickable spans that open trace view, and a timeline highlighting model responses. Decided to use trace_link plugin in Grafana. (Mateo)

2026-02-24: Implementation started - added redwood.error_class and redwood.model_status hooks in runtime branch feature/tracing-enrich. Early tests show fields emitted for model OOM and decode errors. (Mateo)
2026-03-03: Pipeline update - Log team confirmed Loki pipeline can accept new structured keys but recommended restricting freeform.tags to sampled traces. Adjusted sampling rules accordingly. (Lena)
2026-03-08: PR feedback - infra review requested deterministic tag values (no timestamps in labels) and suggested using prometheus histograms with explicit buckets for latency SLI. (Infra team)

2026-03-12: Dashboard prototype - Degradation Map panel draft uploaded, initial heatmap shows good separation between overload and model-decoder failures. Need to add region/model filter and link to trace. (Mateo)
Next: finalize PR, run chaos replay for overload signature, finalize alerts and runbook snippets, schedule onboarding session with SRE and App teams.
qa_notes: QA should run two replay scenarios: (1) synthetic overload by ramping concurrent requests + slow backend to reproduce queueing/timeouts; (2) model-injected errors using test harness to trigger OOM and decode-failure code paths. Verify that dashboards show the expected error_class counts, sampled traces include redwood.model_status, and alerts fire within configured SLO breach windows.
implementation_notes: Runtime change: add TracingEnricher middleware that sets redwood.error_class on exceptions and sets redwood.model_status from model response metadata. Pipe changes: map error_class to prometheus label 'error_class'; add histogram buckets for inference latency (ms): [1,10,50,100,250,500,1000,5000]. Sampling: high-severity tags -> 100% retention; baseline -> 1%. Dashboard: use Grafana heatmap with cardinality-reduction via templated variable for model_version (top N only).
